$comment: Auto-publish guardrails (see CLAUDE.md, 'Auto-publish exception'). The pipeline reads this before it creates any game page. game_pages_enabled is the kill switch: set it to false when Search Console shows fewer than half of the submitted game pages indexed after 4 weeks, and keep it false until that recovers.

kill_switch_review.how: node scripts/kit/gsc/inspect.mjs on every /volleyball/predictions/<slug> URL older than review_after_days, or the Search Console Pages report filtered to /volleyball/predictions/.
